desc: Parse N and S from stdin.
Build parenthesis tree using a stack: for each '(' create a new node, push onto stack; for each ')' pop the top node and link it as a child of the new stack top (or dummy root if stack empty).
After construction, compute for each node the number of direct children (size of its adjacency list).
Compute answer as product of fact[children_count] for all nodes (including dummy root) modulo 998244353.
Handle edge case N=0 (empty string) by outputting 1.
